name: Savings goal
summary: A savings pot with a cover photo: the goal, a ring of how much is saved, what is left and the date it is on track for, a round-ups switch, and quick amounts to add money that move the ring.
use: in a personal banking or budgeting app, for a pot people save toward
a11y: The ring is a progressbar that reads "£1,840 of £3,000, 61%"; round-ups is a whole-row switch, the amounts are a radio group, and each top-up is announced in a polite live region.

use_when: one pot with a target amount, where quick top-ups from the main account should feel immediate
avoid_when: several spending categories against limits: use budget-meters
a split of a total into parts: use donut-breakdown
a target counted in steps or minutes rather than money: use daily-goals

parts.name: cover
parts.what: the photo the saver picked for the pot

parts.name: goal
parts.what: the target amount and the kind of pot

parts.name: ring
parts.what: progress toward the goal, with the percent saved in the middle

parts.name: facts
parts.what: saved so far and still to go

parts.name: on_track
parts.what: the date the pot is on track for and the weekly amount

parts.name: roundups
parts.what: a whole-row switch for round-ups, with this month's amount

parts.name: amounts
parts.what: one quick amount to add; pick one

parts.name: add
parts.what: adds the chosen amount from the named account

parts.name: said
parts.what: a line announcing what was added and what is left

empty.how: the Smart UI renderer puts one plain 'Nothing to show yet.' line in an empty list

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: if a top-up fails, leave the ring where it was and put the reason in the announced line under the button, or use alert-banners

disabled.how: when the goal is reached the Add button turns off and reads 'Goal reached'

overflow.how: on phones the padding and the ring get smaller so the ring and facts still sit side by side

long_text.how: the facts column takes the room beside the ring and wraps there
long_text.evidence: grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: var(--ds-space-inset-xl)

missing_image.how: the Smart UI renderer swaps a photo that fails to load for a block of the same size with its alt text

keyboard: Tab reaches the round-ups switch, the chosen amount, then the Add button
Enter or Space flips round-ups on or off
Arrow keys move between the amounts and pick one; the Add button's label follows
Enter or Space on Add adds the money; the ring moves and the result is announced
